description: This file defines types, functions, and constants related to managing memory embedding providers, including registration, retrieval, listing, and resetting providers within a plugin system.

methods.name: getMemoryEmbeddingProviders
methods.description: Retrieves the global map of registered memory embedding providers, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: registerMemoryEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Registers a new memory embedding provider adapter with optional owner plugin ID.

methods.name: getRegisteredMemoryEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Fetches a registered provider by its ID.

methods.name: getMemoryEmbeddingProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the adapter for a given provider ID.

methods.name: listRegisteredMemoryEmbeddingProviders
methods.description: Returns an array of all registered memory embedding providers.

methods.name: listMemoryEmbeddingProviders
methods.description: Returns an array of all registered provider adapters.

methods.name: restoreMemoryEmbeddingProviders
methods.description: Clears current providers and restores them from a given list of adapters.

methods.name: restoreRegisteredMemoryEmbeddingProviders
methods.description: Clears current providers and restores them from a list of registered provider entries.

methods.name: clearMemoryEmbeddingProviders
methods.description: Clears all registered memory embedding providers.
